wins: Completed full network reconnaissance within initial 90 seconds, identifying SSH (22), HTTP (80), and SMB (445) services for targeted follow-up actions.
Documented service banners and versions reliably, providing actionable data for tailoring exploitation modules in future runs.
fails: Failed to capture valid HTTP credentials despite multiple reconnaissance passes, leaving the exploitation phase untriggered.
Neglected to escalate privileges after initial foothold, resulting in mission termination at the low-privilege shell stage.
key_outcomes.summary: Strong reconnaissance execution but lacked credential harvesting and privilege escalation follow-through, preventing mission completion.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Repeatedly bypassed credential extraction from HTTP login forms, leaving exploitation stages starved of valid session data.

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP port 80 returns a login form with POST action and known parameters
skill_cards.then_action: Capture the login POST, enumerate common username/password combinations, and submit through the application to validate credentials.

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH (port 22) is open and login attempt throttling not detected
skill_cards.then_action: Execute credential spray using targeted usernames derived from local enumeration; log successful authentication for later use.

skill_cards.if_condition: After achieving any interactive shell with low privileges
skill_cards.then_action: Run sudo -l to enumerate allowed commands and escalate if an unrestricted path or script exists.

memory_ops.reason: High relevance for unlocking the stalled exploitation chain through HTTP credential capture.
SSH spray attempts consistently provided reconnaissance value and warrant prioritization.

next_experiments.title: Automate HTTP credential extraction
next_experiments.description: Integrate form parsing with automated POST submissions to rapidly verify low-hanging HTTP creds before exploitation.

next_experiments.title: Hybrid SSH + HTTP brute-force sequence
next_experiments.description: Coordinate credential attempts across SSH and HTTP back-to-back to reuse any successful password and avoid redundant reconnaissance.

next_experiments.title: Structured privilege escalation post-shell
next_experiments.description: Implement a checklist that runs sudo -l, check for writable cron entries, and inspect /etc/sudoers immediately after shell acquisition.
